messages:
Alice: heads-up — CI is red on main after yesterday's serializer change. Failing snapshots in renderer tests. URL: https://ci.example.com/build/2456 :eyes:

Bob: which job? link?

Alice: job: linux-render-serial (failed tests: tests/render/test_prompt_snapshot.py::test_multi_prompt and tests/render/test_serialization_snap.py::test_token_spacing). I ran a quick jq on artifacts: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/2456/renderer/snap-diff.tar.gz

CI-bot: build linux-render-serial #2456 failed — 2 failing tests. Artifacts uploaded: snap-diff.tar.gz

Carol: @Alice thanks. Can you paste a minimal failing diff? If not, run locally:
```
# repro
git checkout main
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest tests/render/test_prompt_snapshot.py::test_multi_prompt -q -k 'prompt'
```
Also try with SERIALIZER_FLAGS=stable to see if quant change.

Alice: here's a small diff excerpt from artifacts:
```
- prompt: "Hello, world"
+ prompt: "Hello,  world"
```
Spacing doubled before world. Looks like serializer added extra space in join path.

Dave: sounds like the tokenizer join change I pushed. @Carol can you try running a quick bisect? If it's the commit I suspect the bisect script is `scripts/find-serializer-regression.sh` — it's fast.

Carol: running bisect now, will update in ~10m. If anyone has a quick revert to test can comment.

Bob: if bisect points to Dave's commit we can revert in a canary PR and rerun CI. Also optional quick fix: add a snapshot filter in render pipeline to collapse multi-spaces.

Carol: bisect done — culprit: commit d4f3a2b (Dave) — introduced change in join logic. Repro locally. Patch would be to trim join or use single-space join. I'll open a small PR with test and fix.

Alice: awesome, thanks. Once PR ready, can we ask CI triage to rerun linux-render-serial only? /rerun job 2456:linux-render-serial

CI-bot: Accepted rerun request for linux-render-serial on build 2456. Queueing job.

Bob: :thumbsup:

Carol: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 — includes test and fix. Patch fixes spacing and adds golden update instructions.

Alice: will merge after 1 LGTM and green snapshot job.

Dave: sorry, my bad — adding extra test locally now too. Thanks all.
